references.text: The same principle of washing clothes after contact with impurity, here after carrying a dead animal.
Parallel law regarding washing clothes after carrying unclean animal carcasses.
Similar regulation about washing clothes after contact with unclean things, for both the one who eats and the one who carries.
Related cleansing instructions where the person who has contact with an unclean person must wash their clothes.
The same chapter describes washing clothes as part of the cleansing process for leprosy.
Law about washing clothes after eating animals that died naturally or were torn apart, parallel to cleansing practices.
The one who gathers the ashes from the red heifer must wash their clothes, corresponding to cleansing rituals.
